name: Half Marble Box
description: A box holds 9 marbles — 6 whole and 3 halves. A half can't be sorted on its own; two halves of the same color must meet on the belt and fuse into one full marble. Crucially, halves only fuse with halves from a DIFFERENT box.
howToPlay: Tap a box to drop its marbles — the whole ones sort as usual, but the 3 halves just circle the belt. Two halves of the same color fuse into a full marble ONLY if they came from different boxes, so you'll need to open a second box of that color. Tip: empty the bottom box to open the ghost box stacked above it. Clear every tray to win!
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Two Halves Make a Whole
showcaseLevel.desc: Halves only fuse with a half from a different box — open both boxes of a color!
